title: Shattered Celluloid Dream
description: A surreal scene of a cracked and crumbling classical theater interior. In the foreground, a woman in a red dress kneels on a broken floor holding a large film reel, surrounded by scattered film strips, a theatrical mask, and a ticket stub, while a massive tear in reality reveals a ballerina in a black and white dress dancing in an art gallery that transitions into a post-apocalyptic ruined city under an orange sky, with radiation symbols floating above.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a classical theater interior violently cracking apart. In the foreground a woman in a red dress kneels on the broken floor holding a large film reel, surrounded by scattered film strips, a decorative mask and a movie ticket. A massive jagged tear splits the scene revealing a graceful ballerina in a black and white dress dancing inside an art gallery filled with statues, which transitions on the right into a dystopian ruined city under a fiery orange sunset sky. Radiation warning symbols float in the upper corner, cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere.
